item.tib: yar me ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchog gi skyes rabs gsol 'debs zla dkar 'od phreng
item.coloph: ces pa'i mchog spral tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi sku phrengagasol 'debs mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang / dbu mdzad rnam dag 'gyur med/ spyang mtshams g.yung drung rgyal mtshan/ g.yung drung rnam dag rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs nye gnas mang pos bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas dag snang gang shar dad mos bcas phul bas dge legs dpal gyi phyogs kun rgyas par gyur cig/
